Name: Dynamic Shader
Author: Nookick
Description:
[b]Dynamic Shader[/b]
A mod that attempts to enhance the visuals in Stardew Valley with dynamic shadows, bloom, god ray, particle effecs, and subtle visual effects or physics effects.

[img width=711]https://pub-dfb42f6896894f6f8095ac8d3bfa0316.r2.dev/General-01.png[/img]

[b]✨ Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Shadows[/b]
Dynamic shadows for buildings, characters, horses, and clouds help objects feel naturally grounded within the scene and aligned with the direction of light.[/*]
[*][b]Tilt-Shift[/b]
The player's position serves as the visual focal point while nearby and distant parts of the scene are softened, creating a miniature tilt-shift photography effect.[/*]
[*][b]Flame Particles[/b]
Light-emitting objects such as torches and active furnaces produce animated flame particles. Their movement responds to the current wind direction for a more natural appearance.
[img]https://pub-dfb42f6896894f6f8095ac8d3bfa0316.r2.dev/Particle-Torch.gif[/img][img width=87]https://pub-dfb42f6896894f6f8095ac8d3bfa0316.r2.dev/Particle-Furnace.png[/img][/*]
[*][b]Wind-Blown Vegetation[/b]
Wind moves large areas of grass in smooth, coordinated waves. Damping and low-frequency noise produce natural bending, inertia, and recovery, while successive moving gusts create lifelike waves across fields of grass.[img width=470]https://pub-dfb42f6896894f6f8095ac8d3bfa0316.r2.dev/Wind-01.webp[/img]
(just a demonstration; the actual mod won’t feature wind this dense.)[/*]
[*][b]God Rays[/b]
Soft God Rays change in color and intensity throughout the day, creating more natural morning, evening, and sunset atmospheres. Characters automatically darken beneath cloud shadows, while the God Rays gradually fade away as night falls.[img width=369]https://pub-dfb42f6896894f6f8095ac8d3bfa0316.r2.dev/General-02.png[/img][/*]
[*][b]Canopy Lighting[/b]
Tree canopies receive time-dependent highlights on their lit sides and deeper shading on their unlit sides, giving trees a stronger sense of volume and a more natural relationship with environmental lighting.
[img width=123]https://pub-dfb42f6896894f6f8095ac8d3bfa0316.r2.dev/TreeLight-Morning.png[/img][img width=140]https://pub-dfb42f6896894f6f8095ac8d3bfa0316.r2.dev/TreeLight-Evening.png[/img][img width=141]https://pub-dfb42f6896894f6f8095ac8d3bfa0316.r2.dev/TreeLight-Noon.png[/img][/*]
[*][b]Bloom[/b]
At night, light-emitting objects gradually develop a soft Bloom glow. Subtle changes in glow radius create a gentle breathing effect.[img width=300]https://pub-dfb42f6896894f6f8095ac8d3bfa0316.r2.dev/Bloom.png[/img][/*]
[/list]
